articles.title: What This Extension Does
articles.summary: A sales and CRM productivity toolkit layered directly onto the golfballs.com admin — templates, tasks, proposals, proofs, and campaigns without switching tabs.

beginner.text: The Golfballs.com extension adds a layer of helper tools on top of the CRM pages you already use. Nothing about the CRM itself changes — the extension watches which page you're on and offers the right tools for it.

rows: Smart templates with live variables, thread previews, case categorization, one-click sends
Margin calculator with real costs, charges/refunds, order dates, watch list, fraud-score glow
Instant search (Ctrl+K), quick tasks, call logging, contact creation, phone finder
Full product catalog with logo/text/monogram customization, gift sets, tracked quote emails
Logo extraction, recolor mockups, 3D ball previews, proof submission
Bulk email from any selection, multi-step conditional outreach with pacing and dry-run

beginner.text: Everything is optional. Each feature has a toggle in Settings → Features, so your team can run as lean or as full a setup as it likes.

articles.title: First Launch
articles.summary: Where the extension's UI lives: the toolbar popup, the floating Actions Shelf, buttons injected into CRM pages, and order-page actions.

beginner.text: After installing, open any golfballs.com CRM page. The extension injects its UI automatically — there is no separate app to open. You'll meet it in four places:

rows: Click the extension icon in Chrome's toolbar
Pick an email template for the current page, see variables resolve live, and reach quick actions
Floating pill, bottom-right of every CRM page (double-tap Shift)
Context-aware launcher: the actions change based on whether you're on an order, contact, or account
Email rows, text rows, and product images on CRM pages
Hover an email row for a thread preview; hover an order image for the Image Viewer
Quick Order Note, Apply last note, and the Order Date Manager

beginner.text: If something listed here isn't visible, its feature toggle may be off — see Settings → Features, or the troubleshooting article "A modal or button isn't appearing".

articles.title: Initial Configuration
articles.summary: The five-minute setup: pick a theme, set your email identity and signature, review feature toggles, and optionally import your team's preset.

beginner.text: Open the Settings page (extension popup → Manage in the header → Settings tab). Six things are worth doing on day one:

items: Confirm your name — Settings registers the current installation to you so API access and anything you share can be attributed. If Email account host is already configured, this happens automatically.
Pick a theme — Dark, Slate, Light, Cream, Nord, Dracula, Rosé, or Tokyo Night. Changes apply live everywhere.
Set your email account host — the 'Email account host' field under Developer Settings controls the From identity on sends. It starts blank and must be configured before Power Automate delivery.
Write your email signature — Settings → signature editor. It's auto-appended to emails sent through Power Automate.
Review feature toggles — everything except Power Automate is on by default. Turn off what you won't use.
Open a team settings link — paste the URL under Shared Settings Templates, preview it, and choose which scopes to import.

beginner.title: No reinstall required
beginner.text: The identity notice updates your existing installation key. It never creates a replacement key, and historical settings or email links pick up the registered name automatically.

beginner.title: Configure the From identity
beginner.text: Power Automate sends fail closed while 'Email account host' is blank, preventing accidental delivery under another employee's identity.
Power Automate is off by default. Without it, Send opens a pre-filled Outlook window instead of sending silently. See "How Email Sending Works" before enabling it.

articles.title: The Actions Shelf
articles.summary: The floating bottom-right launcher on every CRM page. Double-tap Shift to toggle it; its actions adapt to the page you're on and its Help Companion can answer toolkit questions.

beginner.text: The Actions Shelf is a small floating pill in the bottom-right corner of every golfballs.com CRM page. Click it — or double-tap Shift — and it expands into a vertical list of quick actions.

The list is context-aware. Contact/account pages add calling and quick-task actions; order pages add dates and notes; the order index adds Copy order IDs. Four launchers remain available everywhere: Open Image Viewer, Open Contacts, Open Tasks, and Gifting Catalog.

AI Help Companion is the first shelf destination everywhere. Open it to ask how a feature works, where a setting lives, what the current page supports, or how to troubleshoot a workflow. The shelf widens into the conversation; Back returns to actions without stopping a response.
You can close the shelf or navigate while Help Companion is thinking. The service worker keeps polling, saves the answer in extension storage, and shows an unread count on the shelf when it is ready.

rows: Dials the contact (the row hints the number it will dial) and opens the Call Log; shown when the contact has a phone
Opens the Call Log without dialing
Opens Quick Task pre-targeted at this record
Shown instead of Call when the contact has no number but has orders — scans them for one
Opens the Order Date Manager ('Change approval & commitment dates for #…')
Opens the saved-note picker and custom composer
Repeats the last applied saved note template; otherwise opens the picker
Copies every listed ID — the hint counts them ('N orders on this page')
Morphs the shelf into grounded extension help with guide links, safe settings actions, retry/cancel, feedback, and unread replies

intermediate.text: Press Enter to send or Shift+Enter for a new line. Using it focuses on visible controls and operator workflows; Under the hood focuses on architecture, source, storage, and data flow. A response runs in the extension service worker, so Back, outside-click, Escape, page navigation, and MV3 worker suspension do not discard it. Use the stop button to cancel deliberately.

intermediate.title: Grounded knowledge, guarded actions
intermediate.text: The backend searches the generated guide, tutorials, inventory, assistant knowledge bank, personality policy, and safe extension source excerpts. It cannot execute code or inspect customer/page content. Explicit requests can return a typed feature, setting, theme, palette, or share action; both the backend and extension validate it against live registries before it runs.

The companion receives page type, a sanitized route with record identifiers replaced by *, extension version, answer mode, boolean feature state, hidden-setting keys, and ids/names of locally available email templates. It never receives DOM text, customer fields, email bodies, credentials, or arbitrary storage values. Executable actions appear as one-time live receipts; share receipts expose their generated link.

Conversation history is caller-owned and stored locally under gbHelpChatStateV1, capped to 40 messages. The backend receives at most the latest 12 turns for each question and retains completed run recovery only briefly. Clear removes the local conversation; thumbs-up/down records content-free feedback.
Actions added by an open modal

CRM Search adds Run last query and Scan for recent orders while it is open. Task List adds Only overdue + due today (or Show all tasks when active). These entries disappear when their modal closes because the shelf is reflecting that modal's current context.
The expanded panel's header names where you are ('Contact · Marcus Chen'), and actions that fit the current page float to the top. Destructive actions always sit at the bottom in red.

articles.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
articles.summary: Four global shortcuts (all rebindable) plus the in-modal composer keys: '/', 1–9, arrows, and Enter.

beginner.text: Rebind the four letters under Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts. A shortcut only fires when its feature toggle is on.

intermediate.text: Inside composer modals (Quick Task, Call Log)

rows: Pick the Nth filtered template (also picks category chips in Email Preview)
Select / advance to the next composer field
Enter composer mode to fill fields without touching the mouse

intermediate.text: The '/' composer is the fastest way to log a call: '/' → category → direction → note → Enter, all without leaving the keyboard.
